note: Notes for the command list (docs/command_list.md). The list itself comes from the fighter's data: every move in Stances[0].Moves shows up by itself with its input, frame data and animation. Here, keyed by the ENGINE move name (MoveSettings.MoveName), you can give a move a display name, a description, tags, an input to show instead of the worked-out one, which states the preview plays, a group to merge it into, or hide it. extra = rows the data can't show (moves reached by holding a button or by a state change).

5A.desc: Fast jab. Chains into B or C, and into another normal once per chain.

5B.desc: Long-reach mid slash. Your main button in footsies.

5C.desc: Heavy slash. Cancels into specials, EX moves and 6C.

2A.desc: Quick low. Starts most low-to-high pressure.

2B.desc: Low poke. Chains into 5B, 5C, 2C and jump.

2C.desc: Sweep (Sixth Form, Scarlet Sky). Knocks down.

4A.desc: Close slash with a tight hitbox. A fast check up close.

6C.name: Rising Slash
6C.desc: Launches. Any ground normal cancels into it on hit or block. Jump (8) on hit to chase into an air combo; no jump cancel on block.

j.5A.name: j.A
j.5A.desc: Fast air jab. Air-to-air and the start of air combos.

j.5B.name: j.B
j.5B.desc: Wide air slash. Your main jump-in.

j.5C.name: j.C
j.5C.desc: Big downward slash. Ends air combos and covers below you.

Iaido.desc: Stationary quickdraw: a long lightning slash straight ahead.

Iaido: Rising Cut.desc: Quickdraw cut diagonally upward. Anti-air that launches.

EX Iaido: Thunder Barrage.name: Thunder Barrage
EX Iaido: Thunder Barrage.desc: Stationary six-hit slash barrage. The last hit blasts them away (hard knockdown).

Command Dash.desc: A: short dash, B: longer dash. The dash itself doesn't hit. Press A during it for a palm strike, or C (or hold B) for the slash-through: she ends up on their other side, but it is blocked toward the side she came from (never a cross-up).

Command Dash: Pierce.name: Palm Strike
Command Dash: Pierce.desc: A palm strike out of either dash.

EX Dash Slash.desc: Invincible lightning dash. On hit she slashes through them again and again.

Teleport Slash.name: Crescent Slash
Teleport Slash.desc: Two-hit rising crescent slash. A rises about as high as Leticia's 623A and isn't invincible; a hard knockdown early in a combo. B starts invincible and goes higher.

EX Teleport Slash.name: EX Crescent Slash
EX Teleport Slash.desc: Invincible two-hit rising crescent. On hit she turns into lightning at the peak, slashes straight down onto them, holds them while she sheathes, and the click unleashes a last slash (hard knockdown).

Skyfall Slash.desc: Diving slash from the air. Slams airborne opponents down.

EX Skyfall Slash.desc: Invincible dive. The lightning X on landing is a pillar that launches them (+3 on block).

Counter · Thunderclap.desc: Counter stance. When it catches a hit she crosses through them four times, then sheathes on her own side: the final cut lands the moment the blade clicks home.

Throw.desc: Close range. 4 + B+C throws behind you. Break a throw with B+C within 10 frames.

Air Throw.desc: Throw in the air, close range.

Sakura Morning Moon.desc: Invincible lightning dash. On hit she cuts through them back and forth, launches them with a rising slash, then turns into lightning and strikes straight down through them. They hang in the air while she kneels and sheathes: the click sets off the last cut, a burst of cherry blossoms and a white flash. When the screen comes back she is standing and they fall into a hard knockdown under falling petals.

extra.name: Lightning Slash-Through
extra.desc: C during the dash (or hold B): she slashes them from the front and passes through to the other side. Very unsafe on block. On hit they're lifted slightly; a counter hit gives extra time to follow up.
